No copied profiles, no debug profile, no remote-debugging port, no Edge."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Chrome Faithful"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Faithful control of your real, logged-in Chrome profiles.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An MCP server + MV3 Chrome extension + authenticated localhost bridge that lets
AI agents drive the "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"Chrome that already holds your logins, extensions, and
history. No copied profiles, no debug profile"},{"id":"p4s3","text":", no `--remote-debugging-port`,
no Edge, no global mouse/keyboard automation."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Browser-control tools optimize for different jobs:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Approach | What you get | What you lose |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Chrome DevTools MCP (Google) | Excellent DevTools, performance, and CDP workflows; Chrome 144+ can"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" `autoConnect` to a running local browser with user approval | Chrome must already be running, and w"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"hen several profiles are active Chrome chooses the default profile rather than accepting an exact pr"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ofile name |
| Playwright / Puppeteer MCP servers | Deterministic, isolated browsers that are ideal "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"for CI and repeatable tests | Existing logins, extensions, history, and two-factor sessions are not "},{"id":"p9s6","text":"present unless separately provisioned |
| Extension-based MCPs (BrowserMCP, real-browser-mcp) | Cont"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"rol of an existing logged-in browser | A strong fit for live sessions; multi-profile setups may requ"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"ire separate server instances and ports, and normally expect Chrome to be running |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Chrome Faithful focuses on exact-profile, multi-profile control with a
fail-closed local bridge:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Exact multi-profile routing.** Every profile registers with its exact
`profileName`; duplicate r"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"egistrations are rejected, so concurrent agents
cannot interleave inside one profile.
- **Launches a"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" closed profile.** If the target profile — or all of Chrome — is
closed, it starts the *exact* profi"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"le with ordinary Chrome and waits for the
exact extension registration before reporting success. No "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"`--user-data-dir`
hacks.
- **Security depth.** The bridge binds only `127.0.0.1` and requires a
gene"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"rated 256-bit secret. Bootstrap uses one-use tokens; sessions use scoped
grants. Configuration is cl"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"osed-schema and must live outside the source
tree. Installers are transactional with SHA-256-verifie"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"d, DPAPI-encrypted
backups (Windows).
- **File upload the honest way.** Files are injected as page
`"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"File`/`DataTransfer` objects — not `DOM.setFileInputFiles`, not an OS file
chooser.
- **Media export"},{"id":"p11s10","text":" without leaking URLs.** `chrome_page_asset` streams
page-exposed media using the tab's user agent, "},{"id":"p11s11","text":"referer, and matching profile
cookies; signed URLs, cookies, and headers never appear in MCP argumen"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"ts or
results.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- `extension/` — MV3 extension loaded once per controllable profile. Uses
`chrome.debugger`; an **of"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"fscreen document** owns the persistent WebSocket so
MV3 service-worker suspension never drops the co"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"nnection.
- `src/bridge-server.mjs` — authenticated, localhost-only, multi-profile router
with resil"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ient failover.
- `src/chrome-profile-launcher.mjs` — exact local Profile discovery and
ordinary Chro"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"me startup with bounded extension-registration confirmation.
- `src/mcp-server.mjs` — the MCP tool s"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"urface (38 tools).
- `src/agent-browser.mjs` — JavaScript `agent.browsers` compatibility adapter.
- "},{"id":"p14s7","text":"`src/verification/` — challenge detection, hold state machine, handoff,
overlay dismissal, humanized"},{"id":"p14s8","text":" input, and the solve pipeline (checkbox /
slider / click-first generic / capture-for-backend).
- `s"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"rc/file-injection.mjs`, `src/page-asset.mjs`, `src/scroll-capture.mjs`,
`src/scroll-asset-capture.mj"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"s`, `src/network-request.mjs`,
`src/network-response.mjs` — the feature modules.
- `scripts/` — Wind"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"ows installers, acceptance harnesses, live-test harness,
and codex parity tooling."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Safety model"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"1. A caller must select one exact `metadata.profileName`.
2. Duplicate live registrations for one pr"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ofile name are rejected.
3. The bridge binds only `127.0.0.1` and requires a generated secret.
4. Th"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ere is no fallback to a generic profile, port 9222, Edge, or UI automation.
5. If the target is disc"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"onnected, callers use `chrome_profile_catalog` /
`chrome_profile_start`; a process start succeeds on"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ly after the exact
extension `profileName` registers.
6. A live self-test must pass tabs and `Runtim"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"e.evaluate` before browser work.
7. Profile and tab failures are returned to the calling agent with "},{"id":"p16s7","text":"no
user-side console inspection required."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"`chrome_cdp` with `action=send` is outside the safe-projection boundary. It is
equivalent to grantin"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"g the MCP client DevTools access to the selected logged-in
profile. Do not enable this server for un"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"trusted clients or shared MCP hosts."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"See SECURITY.md for the full model and reporting policy."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The extension's broad capabilities are intentional and visible: `debugger`
provides DevTools-equival"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ent control; `history`, `downloads`, and clipboard
permissions back their corresponding tools. Host "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"access is limited to
`http://127.0.0.1/*` for the local bridge. For deterministic, disposable CI
bro"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"wsers, use Playwright or Puppeteer instead."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## DSH first-class integration"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Chrome Faithful ships a first-party DeepSeek Harness bundle in
`packages/dsh-plugin-chrome-faithful/"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"`. It uses DSH's host-provided MCP client
instead of duplicating the browser tools, so DSH gets the "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"same exact-profile
routing and security behavior as every other client."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Supported baseline: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6` and Node.js `>=22.12.0`.
DSH remains an RC, so e"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"very newer RC requires a composition recheck."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Codex compatibility"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"`src/agent-browser.mjs` implements the Codex `agent.browsers` surface. Parity
is pinned mechanically"},{"id":"p25s2","text":": `compat/` holds a repository-authored functional
surface contract, its adapter-map SHA-256, and th"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"e adapter map. It does not
redistribute bundled product documentation. `npm run check:parity` and
`t"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"est/codex-parity-contract.test.mjs` fail if any contract member is missing,
stubbed, or extra. See c"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"ompat/README.md and
docs/CODEX_PARITY.md."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The internal identifiers `agentos-chrome-cdp`, `AGENTOS_CHROME_CONFIG`, and the
existing AgentOS con"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"figuration path are retained for upgrade compatibility;
the public display name is Chrome Faithful."}],"truncated":true}
